description: This file defines a React functional component 'TodoList' that renders a todo management UI. It includes functionalities to list, add, edit, delete, and toggle completion status of tasks, with accessibility considerations and styling based on Figma designs.

methods.name: toggleComplete
methods.description: Toggles the completion status of a todo item based on its ID.

methods.name: startEditing
methods.description: Sets the editing state to true for the specified todo item.

methods.name: saveTitle
methods.description: Saves a new title for a todo item; removes the task if the title is empty.

methods.name: cancelEditing
methods.description: Cancels editing mode for a specified todo item.

methods.name: deleteTodo
methods.description: Removes a todo item based on its ID.

methods.name: addTodo
methods.description: Adds a new todo item with a default title and sets it into editing mode.

methods.name: topForIndex
methods.description: Calculates the vertical position for a task card based on its index to match Figma spacing.
